digest.component_or_area: Gerrit CI/CD workflow - documentation gate routing
propositions: Documentation-only Gerrit changes currently consume the full OS/Python matrix plus mutation and supporting jobs; a reduced docs-only lane should route only when trusted classification proves all changed paths are documentary

A classifier job must execute from trusted origin/main with fail-closed semantics: non-allowlisted paths, empty/malformed diffs, parent-resolution failure, and classifier job failure all select full Verify

Documentation gates (ADR validation, index/link checking, README quickstart, CLI/MCP/env-registry drift) must be extracted into one shared composite action invoked by both full and docs-only routes without adding runner jobs
All structural test consumers of _build-and-test.yml must migrate to follow the extracted gates while preserving their existing invariants; stale gate contracts in vote.needs must be updated
A docs-only change must complete in materially less wall clock and runner-minutes than the baseline full run while retaining all documentation validation
Post-merge production evidence must prove genuine docs-only and non-doc changes route correctly, execute only their respective job sets, and cannot bypass Verified +1 if gates fail
